Treasury Officer Job at Jodazen Integrated Services




        
    

        
        Jodazen Integrated Services is a trusted partner for businesses and individuals seeking seamless HR and travel solutions.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Treasury Officer

Job Location: Mile 2, Lagos

Employment Type: Full-time
Work Mode: Onsite, Monday – Saturday
Industry: Manufacturing

Job Description


	We are seeking a detail-oriented Treasury Officer to support the effective management of the company’s cash flow, banking activities, and financial transactions.


Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Monitor daily cash positions and cash flow requirements.
	Process and monitor payments, transfers, and banking transactions.
	Prepare bank reconciliations and monitor bank balances.
	Maintain accurate records of treasury transactions.
	Liaise with banks on transactions, account issues, and related matters.
	Support cash flow forecasting and liquidity management.
	Monitor incoming and outgoing funds.
	Ensure proper documentation and authorization of financial transactions.


Requirements


	B.Sc. / HND in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related field.
	3+ years of relevant treasury or finance experience.
	Manufacturing experience is required.
	Good knowledge of banking operations and financial controls.
	Strong numerical and analytical skills.
	Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and accounting software.


Salary
N200,000 – N350,000 monthly (based on experience).

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] and copy: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the email.

Quality Assurance Officer Job at DuoTech HR Consulting




        
    

        
        At DuoTech HR Consulting, we understand that the success of any organization lies in its people. We are a leading HR Tech company dedicated to empowering businesses with innovative solutions and cutting-edge technology to transform their human resources practices.

With years of expertise in the HR industry, we have a deep understanding of the challenges faced by businesses today. We believe that every company, regardless of its size or industry, deserves access to top-tier HR solutions that drive growth, improve employee engagement, and maximize productivity.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Quality Assurance Officer
     

            
    



Job Locations: Abuja (FCT) and Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Reports to: City Team Lead
Department: Field Operations

About the Role


	We are looking for a Quality Assurance Officerto join our field operations team in Lagos and Abuja.
	You will serve as the primary quality and operations point at your assigned market, ensuring that orders areaccurate, complete, fresh, and aligned with customer specificationsfrom the time an order is placed through vendor dispatch and drop-off.
	This is a hands-on field role suited to someone who isobservant, trustworthy, detail-oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced market environment.


Key Responsibilities


	Conduct quality checks on orders at assigned markets to ensure accuracy, freshness, and completeness.
	Verify goods against order specifications before dispatch.
	Identify and escalate issues involving damaged, missing, incorrect, or poor-quality items.
	Work closely with vendors to resolve quality and order-related issues.
	Support vendor onboarding and ensure vendors understand quality and order requirements.
	Support consumer acquisition and sign-up activities within assigned markets.
	Capture relevant field data, take photographs, and maintain accurate daily records.
	Submit daily activity and quality reports to the City Team Lead.
	Maintain high standards of professionalism, integrity, and customer service while representing the company in the field.


Qualifications


	Minimum of HND in Food Science, Agribusiness, Nutrition, Logistics, Supply Chain, or a related discipline.
	1–2 years of experiencein food quality, market operations, logistics, retail, supply chain, or a related field.
	Strong fresh graduates withrelevant market exposure, internships, NYSC experience, or practical field experienceare encouraged to apply.
	Practical understanding of food freshness, spoilage, grading, and quality assessment is an advantage.


Skills & Competencies:


	Strong attention to detail and ability to spot quality issues quickly.
	Good knowledge of fresh produce and food quality standards.
	Comfortable using a smartphone fordata collection, photography, communication, and reporting.
	Strong observation, communication, and problem-solving skills.
	Honest, reliable, and trustworthy when handling goods and orders.
	Physically fit and comfortable workingon your feet in busy market environments.
	Ability to work independently and follow operational procedures.
	Fluency in thelocal market languageis strongly preferred.


Consumer Sign-Up Target:
As part of the field operations team, you will also support consumer acquisition within your assigned market:


	Daily: 10 sign-ups
	Weekly: 50 sign-ups
	Monthly: 200 sign-ups


Who We're Looking For:


	We're looking for someone who canspot a quality issue before it reaches the customer, communicate effectively with vendors and field teams, and maintain accurate records even in a busy market environment.


Salary
N150,000 - N200,000 / month.

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and Cover Letter to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

Note


	Only qualified candidates will be shortlisted.
	If you'redetail-oriented, proactive, comfortable working in the field, and passionate about delivering quality, we'd like to hear from you.

        Ascentech Services Limited is a full-fledged Human Resource Solution Provider incorporated in 2013 with its Head Office in Lagos, Nigeria. We are committed to forging long-term partnerships with our clients by creating and delivering robust and flexible services that address the changing needs of their business. 

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Project Manager / Engineer
Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary
     

            
    




	We are seeking an experienced Project Manager / Engineer with strong EPC (Engineering, Procurement & Construction) experience to independently manage and execute Oil & Gas projects from planning through completion.


Key Responsibilities


	Plan, coordinate, and execute EPC projects from initiation to completion.
	Manage project scope, timelines, resources, budgets, and deliverables.
	Coordinate engineering, procurement, construction, and commissioning activities.
	Supervise contractors, vendors, and project teams.
	Ensure compliance with project specifications, HSE standards, and regulatory requirements.
	Identify and resolve technical and project-related issues independently.
	Prepare project reports, progress updates, and project documentation.
	Coordinate activities across Civil, Electrical, Mechanical, and Instrumentation disciplines.


Requirements


	B.Sc./B.Eng. in Engineering or a related field.
	Strong EPC (Engineering, Procurement & Construction) experience is required.
	Proven experience as a Project Manager or Construction Manager; experience in both roles is an added advantage.
	Solid knowledge of Civil, Electrical, Mechanical, and Instrumentation engineering disciplines.
	Proven experience handling Oil & Gas projects independently from start to finish.
	Strong project management, leadership, coordination, and problem-solving skills.
	Ability to manage multiple project activities and deliver within set timelines.
	Strong knowledge of HSE standards and project execution procedures.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CVs to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of mail.
